rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides secure, read-only filesystem access for AI applications. Features directory operations with recursive traversal, search capabilities including file globbing and regex content searching, file reading with head/tail support, and comprehensive analysis tools for directory statistics and metadata. Includes symlink escape protection, path traversal prevention, and access control for explicitly allowed directories only.
